title: TanStack Docs Config
description: Config file for the documentation of a TanStack project.

docSearch.description: Ignored. tanstack.com no longer reads this — the site's search client and index are configured in SearchModal.tsx, not per-library. Safe to delete from your config.

tab.description: Default docs nav tab for every child in this section. Individual children can override it.

badge.description: Free-form tag appended to this page's entry in the generated llms.txt (e.g. "experimental"). Not shown in the sidebar — the sidebar overwrites this with the page's framework provenance.

addedAt.description: Date the page was added (e.g. "2026-06-01"). Shows a "New" pill in the sidebar for 7 days.

updatedAt.description: Date the page was last meaningfully updated (e.g. "2026-06-01"). Shows an "Updated" pill in the sidebar for 7 days.

tab.description: Docs nav tab this page belongs to. Overrides the section's `tab`. Omit to let the site infer one from the labels and path.

badge.description: Free-form tag appended to this page's entry in the generated llms.txt (e.g. "experimental"). Not shown in the sidebar — the sidebar overwrites this with the page's framework provenance.

addedAt.description: Date the page was added (e.g. "2026-06-01"). Shows a "New" pill in the sidebar for 7 days.

updatedAt.description: Date the page was last meaningfully updated (e.g. "2026-06-01"). Shows an "Updated" pill in the sidebar for 7 days.

tab.description: Docs nav tab this page belongs to. Overrides the section's `tab`. Omit to let the site infer one from the labels and path.

collapsible.description: Whether the section should be collapsible.

defaultCollapsed.description: Whether the section should be collapsed by default.

tab.description: One of the docs nav tabs rendered above the sidebar.
